# Design Critique

Use this skill as a design director pass on top of the repository's MUI v6 system.

## Workflow

1. Read [../mui-v6-design/SKILL.md](../mui-v6-design/SKILL.md) first, then [references/critique-checklist.md](references/critique-checklist.md).
2. Focus on the target page, route group, or generated output area instead of giving abstract feedback.
3. Evaluate anti-patterns, hierarchy, composition, density, states, and copy clarity.
4. Report concrete findings first, ordered by impact.
5. If there are no findings, say so and note any residual aesthetic risk or unverified UI area.

## When To Use

- User explicitly asks for design critique or visual review
- Generated UI looks functionally correct but visually generic
- Before a `design-polish` pass on medium or large UI work
- Before handoff when the main risk is design quality rather than code correctness
